description: This file defines the AWS Command class, which implements CommandInterface and serves as a core component for constructing and managing AWS SDK commands, including handling data, handler lists, metrics, and deprecated authentication schemes.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents an AWS command with associated data, handler list, metrics, and optional authentication schemes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Command with name, arguments, handler list, and metrics builder.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the command, specifically cloning the handler list.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command.

methods.name: hasParam
methods.description: Checks if the command data contains a specific parameter.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Retrieves the handler list associated with the command.

methods.name: setAuthSchemes
methods.description: Deprecated method to set authentication schemes for the command.

methods.name: getAuthSchemes
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve authentication schemes associated with the command.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Deprecated method to get a parameter value from the command data.

methods.name: getMetricsBuilder
methods.description: Provides access to the MetricsBuilder instance associated with the command.
